summary: Upper eyelid; its margin normally covers 1-2 mm of the upper cornea. Ptosis lowers it.

margin_height.note: Height of the lid margin above the pupil centre (margin reflex distance 1).

fissure_half_width.note: Half the horizontal fissure width, from the canthi.

fissure_centre_offset.note: Horizontal offset of the fissure centre from the iris centre (+ = toward the lateral canthus), from the canthi. Negative: the fissure centre lies nasal to the cornea.

apex_offset.note: Horizontal position of the highest point of the lid margin.

apex_height.note: Height of the margin apex above the line joining the canthi.

apex_shape.note: How full the arch is; higher = squarer.

crease_height.note: Lid crease above the margin at the apex.

margin_depth.note: Front-to-back depth of the lid margin slab; its anterior edge casts the lid shadow onto the globe.

swelling.note: How far oedema pushes the upper lid margin toward the eye (mm), with the swelling fading over the 4 mm of lid next to the margin; 0 in a healthy lid. Render-calibrated (low confidence).

provenance.source: Margin and apex values derived from the trace in assets/exterior/fissure.json (51.2 px/mm; MRD from the pupil centre (1408, 870) px), checked by the validator within 0.05 mm. Normal ranges: Kanski's Clinical Ophthalmology, 9th ed. Margin depth: Gray's Anatomy (1918) fig. 893; Bron, Tripathi & Tripathi, Wolff's Anatomy of the Eye and Orbit, 8th ed.
